privacy.i: This policy explains how Quickiphone collects, uses, shares, and protects information when you browse our website, purchase an eSIM, connect to a partner network, or contact Support.
s: Scope of this policy

This Privacy Policy applies to Quickiphone websites, checkout experiences, eSIM products, customer support, and related services. It covers information processed directly by Quickiphone and information received from payment, eSIM provisioning, and mobile network partners.
Mobile network operators and payment providers may also process information under their own privacy policies. Their practices are governed by the notices they provide to you.
Information we collect
The information collected depends on how you use our services and which eSIM plan you purchase.
Contact and order information, including your name, email address, billing country, order number, selected destination, plan, price, and transaction status.
Device and eSIM information, such as device type, operating system, language, compatibility results, eSIM profile status, activation timestamps, and technical identifiers needed to provision service.
Network and usage information supplied by connectivity partners, including connection status, serving network, country, data consumed, remaining allowance, and service diagnostics.
Website information, including IP address, browser type, pages viewed, referral source, approximate location, cookie identifiers, and interactions with our website.
Support information, including messages, troubleshooting details, device model, screenshots you choose to send, and records of our communications.
Fraud and security information used to detect suspicious transactions, unauthorized access, abuse, or violations of our terms.
How we use information
We use personal information only where necessary to provide, protect, improve, and communicate about Quickiphone services.
Process orders, confirm payment, issue eSIM activation details, and deliver purchased data plans.
Provision and manage connectivity through eSIM platforms, roaming hubs, and local mobile network operators.
Display plan status, data usage, validity, coverage, and relevant service notices.
Provide compatibility guidance, technical support, troubleshooting, refunds, and customer communications.
Prevent fraud, secure our services, enforce applicable usage rules, and comply with legal obligations.
Analyze website and service performance, improve plan selection, and understand aggregate usage patterns.
Send service-related messages and, where permitted, promotional communications that you can opt out of.
Telecom and service partners

Travel eSIM services depend on specialist partners. We may share limited information with eSIM provisioning platforms, international roaming providers, local network operators, payment processors, cloud hosting providers, analytics providers, fraud-prevention services, and customer-support tools.

Partners receive only the information reasonably needed to perform their services. Mobile operators may generate and retain network records in accordance with telecommunications laws, licensing obligations, and their own retention requirements.
International data transfers
Travel connectivity is international by nature. Information may be processed in countries outside your home jurisdiction when an eSIM is provisioned or connects to a destination network.
Where required, we use contractual, organizational, and technical safeguards designed to protect information transferred between jurisdictions.
Data retention

We retain order, tax, payment-status, support, fraud-prevention, and service records for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this policy and to meet legal, accounting, dispute, and regulatory requirements.
Retention periods vary by record type and jurisdiction. Information that is no longer required is deleted, de-identified, or securely isolated.
Security

We use administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards designed to protect personal information. These may include encrypted transport, access controls, monitoring, data minimization, and restricted staff access.
No online service or telecommunications network can guarantee absolute security. Keep your order email, QR code, and activation details private, as another person may be able to use them.
Your privacy choices and rights
Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict, or receive a copy of personal information, and to object to certain processing.
Use the unsubscribe link in marketing emails to stop promotional messages.
Adjust browser settings or use our cookie information to control optional cookies.
Contact support@quickiphone.com to submit a privacy request. We may verify your identity before completing it.
You may also have the right to complain to your local data-protection authority.
Children

Quickiphone services are not directed to children who cannot legally enter a contract in their jurisdiction. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children without appropriate authorization.
Changes and contact
We may update this policy to reflect changes in our services, telecom partners, legal requirements, or data practices. Material updates will be identified by a revised date or an appropriate notice.
For privacy questions or requests, contact support@quickiphone.com.

terms.i: These Terms govern your use of Quickiphone websites and prepaid travel eSIM services. By purchasing, installing, or using a Quickiphone eSIM, you agree to these Terms.
s: About the service

Quickiphone provides digital eSIM profiles and prepaid mobile data packages for supported destinations. Connectivity is delivered through eSIM platforms, roaming providers, and local mobile network operators.
Unless a plan explicitly states otherwise, Quickiphone plans are data-only and do not include a mobile phone number, conventional voice calls, or SMS.
Eligibility and account information

You must be legally able to enter a contract and provide accurate contact, billing, and device information. You are responsible for access to your email account and for keeping order details and activation credentials secure.
You may purchase a plan for another traveler only if you are authorized to do so and provide them with these Terms and relevant plan instructions.
Device compatibility and unlocking
You are responsible for confirming that your device supports eSIM, is carrier-unlocked, and supports the network technologies used at your destination.

Compatibility information is provided as guidance because manufacturers and carriers may change software, regional variants, or locking policies. A device model being listed as compatible does not override a carrier lock or local restriction.
Installation and activation

Follow the instructions supplied with your order. Most QR codes are single-use and must not be shared. Install over a stable internet connection and do not delete an installed profile while it is needed.
Plan validity may begin at installation, first network connection, or another event stated in the plan description. You are responsible for reviewing the activation policy before installation.
Coverage, speeds, and network availability

Coverage maps, partner names, 4G/5G descriptions, and expected speeds are estimates rather than guarantees. Actual service depends on local network availability, congestion, terrain, buildings, device capability, maintenance, outages, and roaming arrangements.
A partner network may be added, removed, or changed where reasonably necessary to continue providing service. 5G is available only when the plan, device, location, and serving network all support it.
Data allowances and validity

Plans expire when their stated validity period ends or the included data is consumed, whichever occurs first. Unused data has no cash value and does not roll over unless the plan expressly says otherwise.
Data measurements are based on records from our connectivity partners. Device counters may differ because of rounding, delayed reporting, operating-system activity, or different measurement methods.
Acceptable use
You may use the service for lawful personal or business connectivity. You must not use it in a way that harms networks, other users, or our ability to provide service.
Do not use the service for fraud, harassment, unlawful content, unauthorized access, malware, spam, network attacks, or infringement.
Do not resell, transfer, reproduce, or commercially distribute an eSIM profile or activation credential without written permission.
Do not attempt to bypass plan limits, manipulate usage records, interfere with provisioning systems, or use automated methods that create abnormal network load.
We may restrict or suspend service to protect users, networks, partners, or legal compliance.
Orders, prices, and payment
Prices, currencies, taxes, plan inclusions, and promotional terms are displayed at checkout. You authorize the stated charge when placing an order.
Orders may be reviewed, cancelled, or refunded where payment cannot be verified, a plan is unavailable, pricing is clearly erroneous, or fraud is reasonably suspected.
Cancellations and refunds

Refund eligibility depends on the plan, whether the eSIM has been delivered, installed, activated, or used, and whether a verified service fault can be resolved. Contact Support promptly and provide the order number and requested troubleshooting information.

We may be unable to refund a profile that has already been installed or used unless required by law or covered by the applicable refund policy. Changes of travel plans, incompatible or locked devices, and accidental deletion may not qualify.
Support and customer responsibilities

Support may ask you to check settings, provide device details, select a network, update an APN, restart the device, or provide screenshots. You are responsible for following reasonable troubleshooting steps while the plan remains valid.
Do not delete the eSIM before Support confirms that deletion is appropriate. Many eSIM profiles cannot be installed again after removal.
Service limitations and liability

Telecommunications services can be interrupted and are not suitable for emergency calling, safety-critical systems, or any use requiring guaranteed continuous connectivity. Always maintain an alternative way to contact local emergency services.

To the extent permitted by law, Quickiphone is not responsible for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential loss, including missed bookings, lost business, lost data, or reliance on unavailable connectivity. Rights that cannot legally be excluded remain unaffected.
Changes, suspension, and contact

We may update these Terms as services, network arrangements, laws, or business practices change. The version in effect when you place an order generally applies to that purchase unless a change is required by law.
Questions about these Terms can be sent to support@quickiphone.com.

cookies.i: This policy explains how Quickiphone uses cookies and similar technologies to operate our website, remember choices, understand performance, and protect checkout.
s: What cookies are

Cookies are small text files stored by your browser. Similar technologies include local storage, pixels, tags, and software development kits. They can remember a session, store preferences, measure activity, or help protect a transaction.
Some cookies last only for the current browser session. Others remain for a defined period or until you remove them.
Strictly necessary cookies
These technologies are required for core website and checkout functions and generally cannot be disabled through our website.
Maintain navigation, shopping selections, checkout state, and secure sessions.
Prevent fraud, detect abuse, balance traffic, and protect website forms.
Remember privacy choices and other settings required to deliver a requested service.
Preference cookies
Preference cookies remember choices such as language, currency, destination, recently viewed plans, or display settings. Disabling them may cause the website to forget your choices between visits.
Analytics cookies
Analytics technologies help us understand aggregate website use, such as which pages are visited, how visitors navigate, where errors occur, and whether checkout steps perform correctly.
We use this information to improve plan discovery, compatibility guidance, content, reliability, and website performance.
Advertising and measurement cookies

Where used and permitted, advertising technologies help measure campaigns, limit repeated advertisements, and show more relevant offers. These technologies may recognize a browser across websites or services.
We will request consent where required. You can reject optional advertising cookies without losing access to essential website functions.
Third-party technologies
Payment processors, fraud-prevention providers, analytics services, customer-support tools, and embedded content providers may set or read technologies when their features are used.
Third parties control their own cookies and process information under their own notices. Their retention periods may differ from ours.
Managing cookies
You can manage cookies through any consent controls made available on our website and through your browser settings.
Block or delete cookies using your browser's privacy settings.
Use private browsing or device-level tracking controls where available.
Reject optional categories while allowing strictly necessary cookies.
Remember that deleting cookies may remove saved preferences and sign you out of active sessions.
Updates and contact
We may update this policy when our website, vendors, legal requirements, or cookie practices change. The updated version will be posted with a revised date.
For questions about cookies or privacy, contact support@quickiphone.com.
